V x0.5: target metric has no current measurement', E2 48 RUN (same V cap), E8 48 RUN, E9 40 RUN, E4 36 wait — 9 experiments, gate column computed, anti-gaming warnings printed at runtime. Exit 0.

essence: a pipeline that turns frontier scouting into pre-registered, receipt-backed experiments — crossing abstractions systematically instead of by luck at 3am

ideas.name: scout to receipt pipeline
ideas.statement: SCOUT -> CARD -> SCORE -> PRE-REGISTER -> RUN -> RECEIPT -> LADDER-CLAIM is one continuous pipeline: scouts mine sources, claims become abstraction cards, top cards become pre-registered experiments, experiments produce receipts, receipts update the cards, and the loop runs continuously.

ideas.name: crossing abstractions
ideas.statement: Breakthroughs come from crossing abstractions — noticing that system A's mechanism, transplanted into repo B's harness, does something nobody in A or B anticipated — so the registry holds each abstraction as a card with cited instances, the fleet instance, the gap, and the experiment hook.

ideas.name: honesty tags as data
ideas.statement: Every claim carries a honesty tag — VERIFIED (we reproduced or the source shows evidence), REPORTED (strong source, untouched), UNVERIFIED (hearsay) — and the scout protocol enforces 'cite or it didn't happen' with a smallest-build bias and a 25-minute reporting budget.

ideas.name: multiplicative score with a gate
ideas.statement: B = V x F x S (value x feasibility x surprise, 1-5 each) is multiplicative because a zero in any factor zeroes the product; the run gate is B >= 40 AND F >= 3 AND >= 1 VERIFIED citation, with anti-gaming caps (S<=3 for single-lab clustering, V x0.5 unmeasured metrics, F<=2 when Casey must act first).

ideas.name: pre-registration as anti-laundering
ideas.statement: The interpretation is written down BEFORE the run — what would confirm, refute, or bore — sealed pre-draw at a commit with the runner's sha256, arms drawn from a receipted quantum-random channel, and the decide step replayable byte-identically: no pin, no run.

ideas.name: the honest negative is a finding
ideas.statement: E6 slice-2's verdict of record is FAIL — mutation_space_inert: true, cost rule NOT_PAID, no arm met the sealed threshold M >= 1.05 x baseline = 7.4277... AND totalF >= 15, no threshold surgery, no post-hoc metric revision, the 5 frozen-unmeasured arms never peeked — 'an honest negative is a finding, not a gain.'

ideas.name: ladder honesty
ideas.statement: State the RSI position honestly (card C12): most fleet systems are L0; anything claiming L1 needs a held-out gate saying so — a ladder claim without a held-out gate is marketing.

ideas.name: scores become lanes with build sizes
ideas.statement: Scored claims enter the account snowball queue, and DELTAS.md converts registry mechanisms into per-repo deltas with P0/P1/P2 priority and a named first build size (e.g. D1 bug-injection loop: 'one evening, stdlib only') — prospecting ends in scheduled work, not vibes.

parts.name: scout log substrate
parts.essence: Raw claims as blocks: Source (URL/owner+repo+path/commit), Claim (one falsifiable sentence), Evidence (what the source shows), Honesty tag, Abstraction fit, Fleet resonance, Suggested experiment.

parts.name: abstraction card substrate
parts.essence: Numbered cards (C01 frozen-driver ceiling ~2.5 meta-levels, C02 harness-over-weights, ...) each with statement, cited instances, what it explains, our-fleet instance, the gap, the experiment hook; cards are living documents updated by receipts.
parts.failure_mode: a card without a cited instance is speculation (the repo's own one-rule)

parts.name: distill and dedup move
parts.essence: Before filing, check whether an existing card covers the mechanism; add the instance to the card instead of opening a parallel claim — memory grows by accretion, not duplication.
outputs: new card OR instance appended to existing card
parts.failure_mode: parallel claims for one mechanism fragmenting the registry

parts.name: scout discipline rules
parts.essence: Cite or it didn't happen; tag the honesty; one claim per block; smallest-build bias (name the cheapest settling experiment or the claim isn't ready); report by minute 25 even if incomplete; scouts never push — output lands via PR.
parts.gate: scout reports what it verified by minute 25 even if incomplete
parts.failure_mode: endless audits that never report, or scouts committing to fleet repos

parts.name: B = V x F x S scorer
parts.essence: tools/score.py computes the table from a single embedded source-of-truth and enforces scoring.md's anti-gaming rules as printed warnings; scores live in the registry's experiment tables and hand-edited scores must carry a why line.
inputs: EXPERIMENTS table (id, name, cards, V, F, S, verified_citations, needs_casey, metric_measured, why)
outputs: ranked table with B, gate column, warnings
parts.failure_mode: hand-edited scores without a why line
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/tools/score.py header + this lane's live run output

parts.name: candidate run gate
parts.essence: Run an experiment only when B >= 40 AND F >= 3 AND the claim carries >= 1 VERIFIED citation; B >= 60 enters the snowball queue top; 40-59 queued; < 40 stays in the scout log.
parts.gate: B >= 40 AND F >= 3 AND >= 1 VERIFIED citation

parts.name: anti-gaming caps
parts.essence: S capped at 3 when the only instances are one lab or one arxiv week (clustering is not consensus); V discounted x0.5 when the metric has no current measurement; F capped at 2 if Casey must do something first; every cap emitted as a visible warning.
parts.gate: caps applied deterministically by the scorer, visible in output
parts.failure_mode: hype-inflated S or unmeasurable V passing the gate
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/scoring.md 'Anti-gaming notes'; live run warnings '! F cap: external dependency (Casey)', '! V x0.5: target metric has no current measurement'

parts.name: sealed pre-registration
parts.essence: registration.json + registration.md sealed pre-draw at a named commit (e6-slice-2: commit e3f003f, pushed BEFORE any external call) with the runner of record fixed by sha256; the interpretation is written before the run.
parts.gate: registration sealed and pushed before any external call / draw
parts.failure_mode: post-hoc interpretation laundering (the repo's named sin)
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/experiments/e6-slice-2/verdict.md header; registration.json + registration.md present in both slice dirs

parts.name: receipted quantum arm draw
parts.essence: Arms are drawn from a rationed quantum-random channel with a seal receipt (qrng-seal.json, qrng-seal-raw.json), an attempts ledger (qrng-attempts.jsonl), and a channel-health probe receipt documenting a RECOVERED channel — the draw itself is evidence.
parts.gate: draw attempts and channel health are receipted per attempt

parts.name: deterministic decide + replay check
parts.essence: decide.json is produced by a deterministic local replay and decide --check reproduces it byte-identically modulo timestamp, with determinism.json recording TRUE — the measurement can be re-run, not just trusted.
parts.gate: decide --check must be byte-identical modulo timestamp
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/experiments/e6-slice-2/receipts/{decide.json, decide-check.json, determinism.json}; verdict.md 'decide --check byte-identical modulo timestamp, determinism receipt TRUE'

parts.name: per-slice receipt bundle
parts.essence: Each experiment directory carries baseline.json, decide.json, decide-check.json, determinism.json, witness.json, usage.jsonl, health-gate.json, qrng receipts, registration.md/json, arms.json, verdict.md — the run is its own archive.
parts.failure_mode: verdicts without the receipts that produced them
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/experiments/e6-slice-1/receipts/ and e6-slice-2/receipts/ (14 files listed in both)

parts.name: verdict of record with sealed threshold
parts.essence: The verdict states FAIL with verbatim numbers: baseline M=7.07407..., best arm A5 +1.0471% vs gate M >= 7.42777... (= 1.05 x baseline) AND totalF >= 15; every measured arm kept totalF exactly 15; no threshold surgery; 5 frozen-unmeasured arms stay frozen and never peeked.
parts.gate: threshold fixed at registration; measured-but-failed arms published verbatim
parts.failure_mode: moving the threshold after seeing the numbers

parts.name: honest-negative filing rule
parts.essence: An honest negative is filed in the owning repo's FINDINGS.md and said so — doctrine inherited: honest negatives, collapse receipts, 3-root replication, never overclaim the ladder.
outputs: public finding, not a quiet burial
parts.failure_mode: deleting failed runs (the anti-pattern this rule exists to kill)
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/README.md doctrine line + step 6 'Honest negative? File it...'; verdict.md 'An honest negative is a finding, not a gain.'

parts.name: ladder-claim rule
parts.essence: State the RSI ladder position honestly (card C12): most systems are L0; L1 requires a held-out gate saying so — a ladder claim without a held-out gate is marketing.
parts.gate: an L1 claim requires a held-out gate receipt
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/README.md pipeline step 7; abstractions/registry.md C12 reference; DELTAS.md D5 'Ladder positions in README'

parts.name: DELTAS per-repo delta ledger
parts.essence: Account-wide self-improvement deltas applying registry mechanisms (Weco/AIDE^2 + frontier abstractions) to each repo: mechanism -> concrete change -> owning repo -> first build size, prioritized P0/P1/P2.
outputs: DELTAS.md (e.g. D1 bug-injection self-play [P0] 'one evening, stdlib only')
parts.failure_mode: deltas with no owning repo or no named first build
parts.evidence: breakthrough-prospector/DELTAS.md header + MicroMoth-quilt section (D1-D5 as read)

parts.name: snowball queue handoff
parts.essence: queue/snowball.md defines how scored claims enter the account snowball queue — the interface between prospecting and the lanes that will run the work.
parts.failure_mode: scored claims rotting in the registry with no route to a lane

cells.expr: instance joins card, no parallel claim
B = V x F x S with caps as warnings
B>=40 AND F>=3 AND >=1 VERIFIED -> RUN
L0 default; L1 needs held-out gate

layer_logic.0: substrate = two ledgers: an honesty-tagged scout log and a card registry where every abstraction carries cited instances
layer_logic.1: mechanism = score (B=VxF*S), seal (pre-registration @ commit), draw (receipted QRNG), measure (deterministic replay + check)
layer_logic.2: policy = admission gate B>=40/F>=3/VERIFIED, anti-gaming caps, 25-minute scout budget, ladder-claim rule, negatives are findings
layer_logic.3: interface = DELTAS.md per-repo deltas with build sizes and the snowball queue that hands work to lanes
layer_logic.4: evidence = per-slice receipt bundles (14 files), sealed thresholds, byte-identical decide --check, and a published FAIL verdict
